aliases: 网页中间弹出来的窗口

description.zh: 覆盖在页面之上、带半透明遮罩的对话框，打断用户当前流程，要求先完成弹窗内的任务或决策。 遮罩阻断与底层页面的交互，焦点被暂时困在弹窗内，是容器类浮层中打断程度最高的一种。
description.en: A dialog rendered above the page with a translucent backdrop that interrupts the current flow and demands a task or decision first. The backdrop blocks interaction with the underlying page and focus is temporarily trapped inside — the most disruptive of the overlay containers.

use_when.zh: 需要明确决策的破坏性操作（删除、支付）
use_when.en: High-stakes confirmation such as delete or payment

use_when.zh: 任务必须完成后流程才能继续（向导、登录）
use_when.en: A task must finish before the flow continues (wizard, sign-in)

use_when.zh: 需要专注处理的临时内容（详情、快速编辑）
use_when.en: Focused temporary content like a detail view or quick edit

avoid_when.zh: 内容是辅助性的、可随时关闭（改用 popover 或 tooltip）
avoid_when.en: Supporting, dismissible content — use a popover or tooltip

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要对照底层页面操作（改用 drawer）
avoid_when.en: Users need the underlying page for context — use a drawer

avoid_when.zh: 移动端长内容滚动（改为全屏页面更稳）
avoid_when.en: Long scrolling content on mobile — a full page holds up better

disambiguation.zh: Modal 居中打断当前任务、要求处理；Drawer 从侧边滑出保留上下文；Popover 锚定触发元素、非打断；Sheet 只罩住当前窗口（macOS）。
disambiguation.en: A modal interrupts and demands resolution. A drawer slides from the side keeping context. A popover anchors to its trigger without blocking. A sheet covers only the current window on macOS.

note.zh: Drawer 从边缘滑出、空间更大，Modal 居中且更强调打断。
note.en: A drawer slides from an edge with more room; a modal is centered and more interrupting.

note.zh: Popover 非模态、锚定触发器，Modal 遮罩整页并阻断操作。
note.en: A popover is non-modal and anchored; a modal dims the page and blocks.

note.zh: Alert 是页内消息条，不打断；Modal 是必须处理的浮层。
note.en: Alert is in-page messaging; a modal is a blocking overlay.

note.zh: Lightbox 专管图片/视频放大，Modal 承载通用任务。
note.en: Lightbox is media zoom; a modal hosts general tasks.

note.zh: 最经典形态，标题 + 正文 + 操作区
note.en: The classic: title, body and action row

note.zh: 小尺寸，只放一句文案和两个按钮
note.en: Compact, one sentence plus two buttons

note.zh: 移动端常见，从底部升起承接长内容
note.en: Mobile pattern, rising from the bottom for longer content

内容容量.zh: 中，适合短内容与小型表单
内容容量.en: Medium — short content and small forms

移动端友好.en: Medium — go full-screen for long content

notes.zh: 遮罩用 fixed inset-0 + 半透明黑，面板用 flex 居中或 inset-0 m-auto。 打开时锁定 body 滚动，焦点移入面板，Esc 与点击遮罩均可关闭。 入场动画 scale 0.96→1 加淡入，200ms 左右；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Backdrop is fixed inset-0 with translucent black; center the panel with flex or auto margins. Lock body scroll on open, move focus into the panel, close on Esc and backdrop click. Enter animation: scale 0.96→1 with fade, ~200ms; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个模态框（Modal）组件：点击按钮弹出居中对话框，带遮罩层，包含标题、正文和操作按钮。
basic.en: Create a Modal component: a button opens a centered dialog with a backdrop, containing a title, body and action buttons.

design.zh: 创建模态框组件。要求：半透明遮罩 + 居中白色面板（圆角、阴影）；标题区、正文区、底部右对齐操作区（次要按钮 + 主要按钮）； 打开时面板轻微放大淡入；支持 Esc 与点击遮罩关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a modal. Requirements: translucent backdrop plus a centered surface panel (rounded, shadowed); title, body and a bottom-right action row (secondary + primary button); panel zooms in slightly with a fade on open; closes on Esc and backdrop click; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Modal：open 受控；fixed inset-0 遮罩 + flex 居中面板； 打开时锁定 body overflow，焦点移入并做简单 focus trap，Esc 关闭； 入场用 keyframes（scale + opacity），时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)； aria-role="dialog" aria-modal="true"，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Modal: controlled open state; fixed inset-0 backdrop with a flex- centered panel; lock body overflow on open, move focus in with a simple focus trap, close on Esc; enter keyframes (scale + opacity) scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1); role="dialog" aria-modal="true"; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现模态框（Modal）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色、圆角与阴影变量。
用途：删除确认与快速编辑。
要求：
- 遮罩 + 居中面板，Esc 与点击遮罩关闭
- 打开时锁定滚动、焦点移入面板
- 入场动画轻微，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Modal component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface, radius and shadow variables.
Usage: delete confirmation and quick edit.
Requirements:
- Backdrop + centered panel; close on Esc and backdrop click
- Lock scroll and move focus into the panel while open
- Subtle enter animation, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 打开对话框，尝试确认、取消与关闭。
task.en: Open the dialog and explore confirmation and dismissal.

checks.zh: 模态开启期间焦点应留在对话框内。
checks.en: Keep focus inside while the modal is open.

checks.zh: 关闭后回到触发入口，避免丢失操作位置。
checks.en: Return focus to the trigger after dismissal.
